question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

Disease that spreads over a whole country or the whole world
solution:
The correct answer is "**Pandemic**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given question, the given phrase can be replaced by the word "pandemic." 
 
• **The word 'pandemic' refers to a disease that spreads over a whole country or the whole world.**(महामारी)
 
• Examples of pandemics in history include the Spanish flu, HIV/AIDS, and COVID-19.
 
 
• Example: It is to be hoped that they are available before the next pandemic strikes.
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

• Option 2 (Rustic) refers to something that is rural or relating to the countryside.(देहाती)
 
• Option 3 (Panacea) refers to a solution or remedy that is believed to cure all problems or diseases.(सर्वरोगहर औषधि)
 
• Option 4 (Epidermis) refers to the outer layer of skin.(अधिचर्म)
